newsitem.title: ITALY: RUGBY UNION-ITALY TO GIVE MATCH TAKINGS TO CHURCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ITALY TO GIVE MATCH TAKINGS TO CHURCH.

text.p: Deprived children from one of Italy's poorest and crime-ridden neighbourhoods are set to benefit from Australia's opening European rugby union tour match against Italy A on Saturday.

Italian federation vice-president Franco Cimino told a news conference on Monday the proceeds from the match would help Father Alfio Spampinato complete a rugby ground in the poor Catania neighbourhood and to start a club.
He said the gesture was "the start of a real crusade" on behalf of youngsters in poor, crime-ridden neighbourhoods.
Spampinato, chaplain of a local youth prison and a former rugby player, said he had seen how the sport could help juvenile offenders reintegrate into society.
